name: Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-SL9 'Ghost Protocol'
description:
The Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-SL9 is a smart-linked semi-automatic pistol chambered in 9x19mm, featuring full BCI integration through a cranial uplink that connects the shooter's targeting intent directly to the weapon's onboard fire control system. The pistol contains a micro-LIDAR rangefinder, atmospheric sensor, and ballistic computer that continuously calculates point-of-impact and feeds correction data to the shooter's visual cortex through their BCI implant.

The Ghost Protocol represents the convergence of conventional firearms and neural augmentation technology. When a BCI-equipped shooter aims the ARC-SL9, their visual field overlays a real-time hit probability indicator on any target within range. The system accounts for range, wind, target movement, and even the shooter's current stress-induced tremor. An experienced operator with a properly calibrated BCI can achieve first-round hit rates exceeding ninety-five percent at fifty meters — performance that previously required decades of training or a scoped rifle.

Arcturus restricts sale of the ARC-SL9 to Tier 4 and above, and each unit requires registration of both the weapon serial number and the owner's BCI implant identifier. The weapon is inert without a linked BCI — it will not fire. This marriage of weapon to neural implant makes the Ghost Protocol simultaneously the most capable and the most controlled sidearm on the market.
legality: Legal — restricted; requires BCI registration and enhanced firearms license
specifications:
caliber: 9x19mm
effective_range: 75 meters (smart-linked)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 17 rounds
weight: 0.82 kg
BCI_latency: <8ms
tactical_use: A precision smart-linked pistol that dramatically enhances hit probability for BCI-equipped shooters. The neural targeting overlay eliminates most of the skill gap between trained and untrained shooters, making it controversial in professional circles. The BCI-lock prevents unauthorized use but also means the weapon is useless if the shooter's implant is damaged, jammed, or experiencing interference.
cultural_context: The Ghost Protocol is a lightning rod in the debate over augmentation inequality. Critics argue that a weapon requiring a BCI implant — itself a Tier 3+ expense — creates a two-tier system where the wealthy are not only better protected but fundamentally more lethal than the unaugmented. Defenders counter that it makes every shot more precise and reduces collateral damage. Both sides have a point.
story_hooks: An ARC-SL9 fires and kills a target — but the linked BCI belongs to a person who was unconscious at the time. Someone has learned to spoof BCI weapon authorization.
A black-market firmware mod for the Ghost Protocol promises to remove the BCI requirement and is selling for enormous sums. It also installs a backdoor in every weapon it touches.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Siege Mortar SM-8 'Tremor'

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, modular semi-automatic pistol with an almost clinical aesthetic. The frame appears purposefully minimalist — no unnecessary texture or ornamentation. The slide features a subtle ribbed pattern along the top, and the entire weapon has the precision-engineered look of aerospace-grade equipment rather than traditional guncraft. Notable are the small circular sensor pods integrated into the slide and frame, barely protruding but undeniably present.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 19.2 cm | Barrel length: 10.1 cm | Width: 3.6 cm | Height: 13.7 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Exceptionally balanced. At 0.82 kg, it feels lighter than expected for its size — the distribution favors the grip, creating a natural point-of-aim feel. The weight centers naturally in the palm, with no front-heavy drag despite the integrated sensor suite.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy frame with reinforced polymer slide housing the micro-LIDAR and ballistic computer. The barrel is hardened steel.
physical_description.finish: Matte black DLC (diamond-like carbon) coating on the slide with brushed titanium accents around the sensor housings. The frame features a subtle satin-gray anodized finish that resists reflection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal-black primary body with brushed titanium-silver sensor pod accents and minimal accent lines in ice-blue along the frame seams.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with integrated micro-grip patterns — not rubberized, but precision-molded with thousands of microscopic pyramidal surfaces for secure purchase even with synthetic hand augmentations. Slightly cool to the touch.
distinctive_features: Twin circular micro-LIDAR sensor pods mounted flush on either side of the slide, just forward of the ejection port
Barely-visible blue status LED indicator nested in the lower frame rail — glows soft cyan when BCI-linked and active
Minimalist iron sights (backup only) integrated into the slide with almost no profile
Atmospheric sensor intake vents along the triggerguard as fine horizontal grooves
Custom engagement safety: a small neural-touch pad on the grip that activates only when BCI signal is verified
Serial number engraved in microscopic text on the frame side, readable only under magnification
Subtle cooling vents along the barrel shroud in a radial pattern
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: The Arcturus Defense Solutions logo — a minimalist arc symbol — appears in polished relief on the left slide. Below it, stamped in small serif type: 'ARC-SL9 GHOST PROTOCOL | NEURAL-LINKED | BCI REQUIRED'. The model designation and serial number appear microscopically engraved on the frame beneath the triggerguard. No safety warnings or traditional manufacturer text visible at casual glance.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. These weapons are rarely battle-worn because they're precision tools requiring constant calibration. When field-used, they show minor scuff marks on the slide edges and grip sides, but never pitting or corrosion — the DLC and anodizing prevent degradation. Some units display accumulated dust in the sensor vents from active use.
